description: Lyra | Full-Time | Applied AI Engineer | REMOTE (US Citizenship Required) | Building the AI that builds satellites. Lyra is building an AI-native platform to solve the problem of mission integration that exists today: a slow, expensive, and manual process of information extraction and design for satellite missions. You will work on a small, fast-paced team that interfaces directly with government agencies and industry experts to build the initial version of our platform. We are looking for a generalist that is comfortable building full-stack products, using AI tooling, and building data analysis/extraction pipelines. Package: Health insurance, generous equity, competitive salary Email: tanmayi@lyraspace.co Website: https://lyraspace.co/
